purpose: Keep regression/development cases separate from a frozen held-out evaluation candidate set.

regression.role: Development and regression testing; may be inspected while changing rules.

held_out.role: Frozen evaluation candidate set; do not use its errors to tune classifier rules.
held_out.limitation: These labels are provisional and not independently double-annotated. Independent human review and adjudication are required before reporting this as an independent benchmark.

policy: Never merge held-out cases into regression cases for tuning.
Do not modify held-out expected labels after inspecting model predictions; log adjudicated corrections separately.
Report sample counts and per-label support with every score.
A synthetic, single-annotator holdout is a leakage-control measure, not evidence of independent ground truth.
